audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Cassiopeia while the content layer and packet both read Skill/Skill/Skill/Cassiopeia/Annie/Cassiopeia/Annie — four rows disagreed across the two layers.
audit.why: Cassiopeia's Q reaches 850 to Annie's 625 and Twin Fang heals off her own poison, so 4-5 and the first item are hers; Annie's Pyromania-into-Tibbers owns 6 and the two-item burst window.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side realigned to the content/packet chart with ratings and whys following.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] called her ultimate 'Petrify' and spikes[3] said Annie one-shots her 'from stealth'. Annie has no stealth in her kit, and the ultimate is Petrifying Gaze.
audit.why: ownerKit has no stealth flag on any slot; enemy R is Petrifying Gaze, 120/100/80s, 825 range.
audit.corrected: Real name used, the fabricated stealth replaced with a flank, and the 120s rank-1 cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interaction errors. (a) Text repeatedly attributes grounding to Twin Fang ('grounded Twin Fang stacking', 'Poke with Noxious Blast to ground you'); grounding is Miasma (W) only. (b) The whole page treats Miasma's grounding as matchup-defining, but Annie's kit contains no dash, leap or movement ability for it to disable — the real cost of Miasma is its slow and the poison it applies.
audit.why: Riot text: Miasma 'slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging'; 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities'. Twin Fang's text has no grounding, only bonus damage to poisoned targets plus healing. Annie's Q/W/E/R are all non-movement.
audit.corrected: Grounding reassigned to Miasma, its 24/22/20/18/16 cooldown given as the actual punish window, and the focus moved to Twin Fang's 0.75s heal cycle. Also added: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her and merely slows those turned away.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only once, vaguely, in report[8]; nothing in the trading or behind-text told you why it mattered.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'needs-antiheal' — Twin Fang heals for a percentage of damage dealt on a 0.75s cooldown, so Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb named in breakdown.feeding and Twin Fang's heal named in breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Hold the four-stack glow and watch him orbit at max range — a stocked Annie controls the lane by standing there.
edits.after: Twin Fang ramps here: her 0.75s cycle heals through your chip, so trade in one stocked burst and leave immediately.

edits.before: Luden's/Stormsurge spike: the stun-burst math kills through Doran's defenses. Stock, walk forward, win.
edits.after: Her first-item poison scaling beats your flatter curve — farm, hold the glow, take only stun-opened trades.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by poisoning you at 850 range and healing it all back through Twin Fang's 0.75s cycle.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Molten Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: 24s at rank 1 — the grounding costs you nothing, since you have no dash; the slow and the poison it leaves cost everything. - Twin Fang cycles every 0.75s and heals: buy anti-heal. - Tibbers goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: If Cassiopeia gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Miasma extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Cassiopeia gets a kill, buy Oblivion Orb — Twin Fang's healing is what turns her lead into a lane. Farm with Q refunds from outside 850, and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry the one button — Flash-Tibbers onto Cassiopeia before Petrifying Gaze turns; her 825 range is your radius.

edits.before: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, zone Cassiopeia off CS by existing, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.
edits.after: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, deny her the poison stacks she heals off, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Miasma is down 24s at rank 1 — bait the cloud, count it out, then step in.

edits.before: Cassiopeia burns Miasma on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Cassiopeia burns Miasma on a minion — take the twenty-second invitation.

edits.before: That is Cassiopeia’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Her Q outranges yours 850 to 625; walking in unstacked only feeds Twin Fang.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 favor Cassiopeia: grounded Twin Fang stacking begins to outpace Annie's trade damage in prolonged exchanges.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favor Cassiopeia: Twin Fang healing off her own poison outpaces Annie's trade damage in prolonged exchanges.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's Noxious Blast poke plus grounded Twin Fang stacks does real damage if you facecheck it, but her range advantage is small enough that a well-timed stun punishes her hard.
edits.after: Noxious Blast poisons you at 850 and Twin Fang then hits harder and heals her every 0.75s — but Miasma, her only lockdown, is down 20s, and that gap is your stun window.

edits.before: Petrify is a game-ending stun-lock into full combo, but it has a long cooldown and telegraph — your own Pyromania stun window can beat her to the punch if you engage first.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her — anyone turned away is merely slowed — and it is 120s at rank 1, so a stocked Pyromania beats her to the punch.

edits.before: Annie can still one-shot her from stealth with P+Tibbers before she gets a full grounded rotation off, but if she opens on you first, Petrify locks you down for the kill.
edits.after: Annie still one-shots her from a flank with P+Tibbers before Twin Fang ramps, but if Petrifying Gaze catches you facing her, that 825-range stun is the kill.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's power spikes hard once she hits 2 items and can chain Twin Fang stacks into deleted health bars, so from level 6 onward respect her engage range — Petrify has serious lockdown potential if she catches you out of position. Your own Tibbers plus stun is a faster, more reliable kill tool at 6 if you get there first; look to all-in the instant she overextends for CS or misses a poke. Ward her flank routes since she loves to roam once ahead.
edits.after: Cassiopeia spikes hard once she hits 2 items and chains Twin Fang into deleted health bars, so from level 6 respect her 825 ultimate range — Petrifying Gaze stuns only what is facing her, so turning and running downgrades it to a slow. Your Tibbers plus stun is the faster kill tool at 6 if you get there first; all-in the instant she overextends for CS or burns Miasma. Ward her flank routes since she roams once ahead.

edits.before: Cassiopeia is a nightmare in extended teamfights with Rylai's/Liandry's DoT stacking and Petrify area-lock, so Annie needs to either burst her down from a flank before she reacts, or bait Petrify onto a teammate. Full-combo one-shot with Tibbers is still Annie's best answer if she can land the initial stun; otherwise this becomes a positioning war where whoever finds the pick first usually wins the fight.
edits.after: Cassiopeia is a nightmare in extended fights with Rylai's/Liandry's poison stacking and an 80s Petrifying Gaze, so Annie either bursts her from a flank before she turns, or the team walks out of the cone facing away and eats a slow instead. Full-combo one-shot with Tibbers is still the best answer when the stun lands first; otherwise this is a positioning war and whoever finds the pick wins.

edits.before: Poke with Noxious Blast to ground you and set up Twin Fang
edits.after: Poison you with Noxious Blast so Twin Fang hits harder

notes: Chart was split across layers on four rows; proposed as one atomic group on the full side (content already matched the packet). Recurring factual error corrected in three places: grounding was attributed to Twin Fang, it belongs to Miasma. Fabrication removed: spikes[3] claimed Annie one-shots 'from stealth' — Annie has no stealth. Unverified and therefore left alone: whether Flash still functions while Grounded (Riot's text says 'Movement abilities' and Flash is a summoner spell, but the kit file cannot settle it, so no page text asserts it). Left templated but ungroundable without invention: breakdown.wave, breakdown.mid, breakdown.late, breakdown.early, tradeGood/tradeBad.
